select_texts.sql: SELECT turn_id,attempt_ordinal,resolution_code,interrupted_by_command_key FROM model_operation WHERE operation_id=?1
SELECT turn_id,attempt_ordinal,interrupted_by_command_key FROM model_operation WHERE operation_id=?1

SELECT workspace,model,instructions_content_id,tools_mask,permission_mode,output_schema_content_id,revision,next_position,provider,compaction_trigger,output_reservation FROM session WHERE session_ref=?1
SELECT byte_length,digest,private FROM content WHERE content_id=?1
SELECT kind,target,input_digest,accepted,code,revision,created,primary_content_id FROM core_command WHERE command_key=?1
SELECT content_id FROM content WHERE digest=?1 AND byte_length=?2 AND private=0
SELECT content_id FROM content WHERE digest=?1 AND byte_length=?2 AND private=?3

SELECT position,kind,content_id,model,provider,item_kind,item_id_digest,valid_owner,sender FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.session_position AS position,e.entry_kind AS kind,e.content_id AS content_id,NULL AS model,NULL AS provider,NULL AS item_kind,NULL AS item_id_digest,NULL AS valid_owner,(SELECT m.sender_session_ref FROM message_admission m WHERE e.entry_kind=1 AND m.admission_id=e.source_admission_id) AS sender FROM model_operation current JOIN conversation_entry e ON e.session_ref=current.session_ref WHERE current.operation_id=?1 AND e.session_position>?2 AND e.session_position<current.admission_position AND e.entry_kind IN (1,2) ORDER BY e.session_position LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT item.session_position AS position,3 AS kind,item.content_id AS content_id,r.model AS model,r.provider AS provider,item.item_kind,item.item_id_digest,owner.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','tool_proposals') AND owner.session_ref=item.session_ref AND owner_turn.session_ref=item.session_ref AND owner.attempt_ordinal=item.attempt_ordinal AND owner.admission_position<item.session_position AND owner.admission_position<current.admission_position AND (item.item_kind!=3 OR owner.resolution_code='tool_proposals') AND ((owner.resolution_code='tool_proposals')=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_tool_call call WHERE call.operation_id=owner.operation_id)) AS valid_owner,NULL AS sender FROM model_operation current JOIN model_output_item item ON item.session_ref=current.session_ref LEFT JOIN model_operation owner ON owner.operation_id=item.operation_id LEFT JOIN turn owner_turn ON owner_turn.turn_id=owner.turn_id LEFT JOIN session_revision r ON r.session_ref=owner.session_ref AND r.revision=owner.settings_revision WHERE current.operation_id=?1 AND item.session_position>?2 AND item.session_position<current.admission_position ORDER BY item.session_position LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY position LIMIT 1

SELECT operation.operation_id FROM turn active JOIN model_operation operation ON operation.operation_id=active.operation_id WHERE active.outcome_code IS NULL AND operation.resolution_code='tool_proposals' ORDER BY operation.operation_id
SELECT action_id,parent_operation_id FROM action_operation INDEXED BY action_operation_unresolved_attempt WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal=1 ORDER BY action_id LIMIT ?1

SELECT action.action_id,action.parent_operation_id,operation.turn_id,action.bash_timeout_override_ms FROM action_operation action INDEXED BY action_operation_executable JOIN model_operation operation ON operation.operation_id=action.parent_operation_id JOIN turn active ON active.turn_id=operation.turn_id WHERE action.permission_state=1 AND action.resolution_code IS NULL AND action.attempt_ordinal=0 AND active.outcome_code IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.selected_turn_id=active.turn_id) ORDER BY action.action_id LIMIT 1

SELECT 1 FROM message_admission m INDEXED BY message_admission_pending WHERE m.turn_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.session_ref=m.session_ref  AND m.admission_id<=stopped.admission_cutoff) AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=active.operation_id  WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL  AND (current.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','interrupted','context_overflow') OR (current.resolution_code='tool_proposals' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM model_tool_call call WHERE call.operation_id=current.operation_id)=( SELECT count(*) FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item LEFT JOIN model_tool_call call  ON call.operation_id=item.operation_id AND call.item_ordinal=item.item_ordinal  LEFT JOIN action_operation action ON action.parent_operation_id=call.operation_id  AND action.call_ordinal=call.call_ordinal WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3 AND ( call.operation_id IS NULL OR (call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS NULL OR action.resolution_code IS NULL)))))))) LIMIT 1

SELECT active.session_ref,active.first_admission_id,active.input_cutoff,0,s.revision,s.next_position,active.turn_id FROM turn active JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=active.operation_id JOIN session s ON s.session_ref=active.session_ref WHERE active.outcome_code IS NULL AND (current.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','context_overflow') OR current.resolution_code='tool_proposals' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM model_tool_call call WHERE call.operation_id=current.operation_id)=( SELECT count(*) FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item LEFT JOIN model_tool_call call  ON call.operation_id=item.operation_id AND call.item_ordinal=item.item_ordinal  LEFT JOIN action_operation action ON action.parent_operation_id=call.operation_id  AND action.call_ordinal=call.call_ordinal WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3 AND ( call.operation_id IS NULL OR (call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS NULL OR action.resolution_code IS NULL))))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_admission m WHERE m.session_ref=active.session_ref AND m.turn_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.session_ref=m.session_ref  AND m.admission_id<=stopped.admission_cutoff) AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=active.operation_id  WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL  AND (current.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','interrupted','context_overflow') OR (current.resolution_code='tool_proposals' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM model_tool_call call WHERE call.operation_id=current.operation_id)=( SELECT count(*) FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item LEFT JOIN model_tool_call call  ON call.operation_id=item.operation_id AND call.item_ordinal=item.item_ordinal  LEFT JOIN action_operation action ON action.parent_operation_id=call.operation_id  AND action.call_ordinal=call.call_ordinal WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3 AND ( call.operation_id IS NULL OR (call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS NULL OR action.resolution_code IS NULL))))))))) ORDER BY current.operation_id LIMIT 1
SELECT admission_id FROM message_admission ORDER BY admission_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT current.purpose,current.resolution_code,current.operation_id,latest.outcome_code,latest.first_admission_id FROM turn latest INDEXED BY turn_session_latest LEFT JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=latest.operation_id WHERE latest.session_ref=?1 ORDER BY latest.turn_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT turn_id FROM turn ORDER BY turn_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT operation_id FROM model_operation ORDER BY operation_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*) FROM session_revision r WHERE r.session_ref=?1 AND r.revision>coalesce((SELECT max(e.source_revision) FROM conversation_entry e WHERE e.session_ref=?1),1) AND r.revision<=?2 AND r.instructions_updated=1

SELECT r.model,baseline.instructions_content_id,r.output_schema_content_id,r.tools_mask,r.provider,o.session_ref,r.workspace,o.compaction_trigger,o.output_reservation FROM model_operation o JOIN session_revision r ON r.session_ref=o.session_ref AND r.revision=o.settings_revision JOIN session_revision baseline ON baseline.session_ref=o.session_ref AND baseline.revision=1 WHERE o.operation_id=?1
SELECT purpose FROM model_operation WHERE operation_id=?1

SELECT current.admission_position,coalesce((SELECT base.admission_position FROM model_operation base INDEXED BY model_operation_compaction_bases WHERE base.session_ref=current.session_ref AND base.purpose=1 AND base.resolution_code='compacted' AND base.admission_position<current.admission_position ORDER BY base.admission_position DESC LIMIT 1),0) FROM model_operation current WHERE current.operation_id=?1

SELECT source.operation_id,source.admission_position,source.output_item_count,source.purpose FROM model_operation current JOIN model_operation source INDEXED BY model_operation_context_history ON source.session_ref=current.session_ref WHERE current.operation_id=?1 AND source.admission_position>=?2 AND (source.admission_position,source.operation_id)>(?3,?5) AND source.admission_position<?4 AND source.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','tool_proposals') ORDER BY source.admission_position,source.operation_id LIMIT 1

SELECT base.operation_id FROM model_operation current JOIN model_operation base INDEXED BY model_operation_compaction_bases ON base.session_ref=current.session_ref WHERE current.operation_id=?1 AND base.purpose=1 AND base.resolution_code='compacted' AND base.admission_position<current.admission_position ORDER BY base.admission_position DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT source.operation_id,current.admission_position,source.resolution_code='tool_proposals',source.admission_position,source.output_item_count FROM model_operation current JOIN model_operation source INDEXED BY model_operation_session_history ON source.session_ref=current.session_ref WHERE current.operation_id=?1 AND source.operation_id>?2 AND source.operation_id<current.operation_id ORDER BY source.operation_id LIMIT 1

SELECT turn_id,operation_id FROM model_operation INDEXED BY model_operation_retry_exhausted WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND uncertain=1 AND allowance_used=4 AND retry_due_at_ms=0 ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT ?1
SELECT CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)

SELECT turn_id,operation_id,attempt_ordinal,allowance_used,retry_due_at_ms FROM model_operation INDEXED BY model_operation_retry_due WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND allowance_used<4 AND retry_due_at_ms<=?1 ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT ?2
SELECT turn_id,attempt_ordinal,interrupted_by_command_key FROM model_operation WHERE operation_id=?1
SELECT action_id,parent_operation_id FROM action_operation INDEXED BY action_operation_unresolved_attempt WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal=1 ORDER BY action_id LIMIT ?1

SELECT turn_id,operation_id FROM model_operation INDEXED BY model_operation_retry_exhausted WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND uncertain=1 AND allowance_used=4 AND retry_due_at_ms=0 ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT ?1
SELECT turn_id,attempt_ordinal,interrupted_by_command_key FROM model_operation WHERE operation_id=?1
SELECT kind,target,input_digest,accepted,code,revision,created,primary_content_id FROM core_command WHERE command_key=?1

SELECT operation.operation_id FROM turn active JOIN model_operation operation ON operation.operation_id=active.operation_id WHERE active.outcome_code IS NULL AND operation.resolution_code='tool_proposals' ORDER BY operation.operation_id

SELECT workspace,model,instructions_content_id,tools_mask,permission_mode,output_schema_content_id,revision,next_position,provider,compaction_trigger,output_reservation FROM session WHERE session_ref=?1
SELECT coalesce(max(admission_id),0) FROM message_admission WHERE session_ref=?1
SELECT t.turn_id,t.operation_id,o.resolution_code FROM turn t JOIN model_operation o ON o.operation_id=t.operation_id WHERE t.session_ref=?1 AND t.outcome_code IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM action_operation WHERE parent_operation_id=?1 AND resolution_code IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal=0
SELECT session_ref FROM turn WHERE turn_id=?1 AND outcome_code IS NOT NULL AND outcome_position IS NULL
SELECT outcome_code FROM turn WHERE turn_id=?1
SELECT byte_length,digest,private FROM content WHERE content_id=?1

SELECT m.session_ref,m.content_id,m.admission_id,m.command_key,m.turn_id,t.operation_id,o.attempt_ordinal,t.outcome_code,t.outcome_content_id,CASE WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT stopped.command_key FROM session_stop stopped JOIN core_command stop_command ON stop_command.command_key=stopped.command_key WHERE stopped.session_ref=m.session_ref AND m.admission_id<=stopped.admission_cutoff ORDER BY stop_command.rowid LIMIT 1) END FROM message_admission m LEFT JOIN turn t ON t.turn_id=m.turn_id LEFT JOIN model_operation o ON o.operation_id=t.operation_id WHERE m.command_key=?1
SELECT action_id,parent_operation_id FROM action_operation INDEXED BY action_operation_unresolved_attempt WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND attempt_ordinal=1 ORDER BY action_id LIMIT ?1

SELECT action.action_id,action.parent_operation_id,operation.turn_id,action.bash_timeout_override_ms FROM action_operation action INDEXED BY action_operation_executable JOIN model_operation operation ON operation.operation_id=action.parent_operation_id JOIN turn active ON active.turn_id=operation.turn_id WHERE action.permission_state=1 AND action.resolution_code IS NULL AND action.attempt_ordinal=0 AND active.outcome_code IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.selected_turn_id=active.turn_id) ORDER BY action.action_id LIMIT 1

(call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS NULL OR action.resolution_code IS NULL))))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_admission m WHERE m.session_ref=active.session_ref AND m.turn_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.session_ref=m.session_ref  AND m.admission_id<=stopped.admission_cutoff) AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=active.operation_id  WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL  AND (current.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','interrupted','context_overflow') OR (current.resolution_code='tool_proposals' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM model_tool_call call WHERE item LEFT JOIN model_tool_call call  ON call.operation_id=item.operation_id AND call.item_ordinal=item.item_ordinal  LEFT JOIN action_operation action ON action.parent_operation_id=call.operation_id  AND action.call_ordinal=call.call_ordinal WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3 AND ( call.operation_id IS NULL OR (call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS SELECT 1 FROM message_admission m INDEXED BY message_admission_pending WHERE m.turn_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM session_stop stopped WHERE stopped.session_ref=m.session_ref  AND m.admission_id<=stopped.admission_cutoff) AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM turn active JOIN model_operation current ON current.operation_id=active.operation_id  WHERE active.session_ref=m.session_ref AND active.outcome_code IS NULL  AND (current.resolution_code IN ('answer','compacted','interrupted','context_overflow') OR (current.resolution_code='tool_proposals' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM model_tool_call call WHERE call.operation_id=current.operation_id)=( SELECT count(*) FROM model_output_item item WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM model_output_item item LEFT JOIN model_tool_call call  ON call.operation_id=item.operation_id AND call.item_ordinal=item.item_ordinal  LEFT JOIN action_operation action ON action.parent_operation_id=call.operation_id  AND action.call_ordinal=call.call_ordinal WHERE item.operation_id=current.operation_id AND item.item_kind=3 AND ( call.operation_id IS NULL OR (call.rejection_code IS NULL AND (action.action_id IS NULL OR action.resolution_code IS NULL)))))))) LIMIT 1

SELECT turn_id,operation_id FROM model_operation INDEXED BY model_operation_retry_exhausted WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND uncertain=1 AND allowance_used=4 AND retry_due_at_ms=0 ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT ?1
SELECT CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)

SELECT turn_id,operation_id,attempt_ordinal,allowance_used,retry_due_at_ms FROM model_operation INDEXED BY model_operation_retry_due WHERE resolution_code IS NULL AND allowance_used<4 AND retry_due_at_ms<=?1 ORDER BY operation_id LIMIT ?2

limits: One post-fix HOLD100 window only. SQL first executions, not completions; logged wall-clock intervals are count denominators, not CPU or natural wakeups. Admission and explicit cancellation/drain are outside the held window. No matched new HOLD0 or repeat statistics.
